title: Feasibility difficulty near the boundary
input_provenance: Random instances use NumPy PCG64, with saved arrays and seeds. They are method reproductions; MATLAB rand(state,...) uses v5uniform and randn(state,...) uses v5normal, whereas seed selects the v4 family. Equal integer seeds do not identify equal arrays. No exact MATLAB fixture was published in the checked companion sources; exact book-figure matching is not claimed.
notes: The unpublished original A, b and perturbation are replaced by the explicit seed-1110 family above. The 40-value main sweep, positive/negative near-boundary range down to 1e-6 and 25 positive infeasible-start tests are executed. Exact counts and slopes depend on the instance, so no claim is made to match the original curves.
